project: Fixing a broken WordPress plugin for a friend's travel blog
text: Nadia sorted out a broken WordPress plugin for my friend's site and had it back up in an afternoon. The dashboard is now stable and visitors can book trips again without hiccups. Very reliable work, and I’d rate it five stars.

project: Production pipeline for a credit-scoring model
text: Nadia built a production pipeline for our credit‑scoring model, shifting releases from a monthly manual process to an automated weekly one. We caught two drift incidents early, which saved us potential losses. The only downside was a slight delay in the initial handover, but overall a solid four‑star delivery.

project: Daily demand forecast for a bakery chain
text: Nadia delivered a daily demand forecast for our nine bakery locations, and waste fell by 12% across the board. The forecasts are easy to read on the new dashboard and have helped us plan staff rosters more efficiently. Absolutely five stars.

project: Cleaning a messy survey dataset for a PhD researcher
text: Nadia cleaned a chaotic survey dataset, merging 18 files into a single tidy table and providing a clear data dictionary. The result was a dataset ready for analysis without any missing metadata. Her meticulous approach earned a full five‑star rating.

Nadia reviewed machine‑translated Urdu product copy, correcting 1,200 strings. The quality improved noticeably, though the turnaround was a couple of days longer than promised, which impacted our launch schedule. I give her three stars for the effort.

Nadia created an automatic routing system for support tickets, now handling 72% of them without human intervention. First‑response times fell by 40%, and the support team can focus on complex cases. Communication was clear throughout, earning a five‑star rating.

project: CV parsing for an HR start-up
text: Nadia developed a CV parsing tool that achieved 91% field accuracy on 500 resumes. The new system feeds directly into our recruitment dashboard. There was a brief period of scope confusion about custom fields, but she resolved it quickly. Four stars.

Nadia set up an extraction system for invoices and bills of lading, processing 9,000 documents a month and cutting manual key‑in work by 80%. The interface is intuitive, though the initial rollout took a week longer than we hoped. Four stars overall.

project: Contract question-answering assistant with an evaluation harness
text: Nadia built a contract question‑answering assistant with an evaluation harness. Answer accuracy rose from 61% to 86% on our test set, and unsupported citations are now virtually nonexistent. The bot has become a trusted tool for our legal team. Five stars.

Nadia delivered an image classifier for surface defects, achieving a recall of 0.94 on cracked parts and replacing a manual spot‑check process. The system integrates smoothly with our existing dashboard. Very pleased – five stars.

project: Voice-of-customer topic mining on product reviews
text: Nadia mined our product reviews for recurring issues, surfacing three key defects that have since reduced returns on those SKUs by 6%. The insights were presented clearly in the new analytics view. Excellent work, five stars.

project: FAQ chatbot for a small online store
text: Nadia created an FAQ chatbot for our small online store, handling about 60% of customer queries without staff involvement. The bot’s answers are generally accurate, though it occasionally struggled with very niche product details, which required manual tweaks. Four stars.

project: LLM lead-qualification agent inside a real-estate CRM
text: Nadia integrated an LLM lead‑qualification agent into our CRM, cutting lead qualification time from two days to three hours. Agents now reclaim roughly six hours each week. The only issue was a brief lag in the early testing phase, but it was resolved swiftly. Five stars.

project: Batch transcription and chaptering for a podcast network
text: Nadia built a batch transcription and chaptering pipeline for our podcast network, delivering 400 back‑catalogue episodes transcribed and chaptered within a week. The new system is now part of our editorial workflow. Very efficient work, five stars.
